title: Scout Playbook Index
description: Machine-checkable contract for the per-repo playbook INDEX (v0.3). Lives at .claude/scout/playbooks/INDEX.md; /scout:author and /scout:harvest append an entry on every write; /scout:investigate and /scout:runbook read it FIRST to route by natural language, then open only the matched playbook(s). Minimal by design: enough to ROUTE, never a duplicate of the playbook. See index.schema.md for the normative prose spec.

generated_by.description: OPTIONAL. Tool/skill that last wrote the index.

generated_at.description: OPTIONAL. Quoted timestamp of the last write.

playbooks.description: The routing entries. One per playbook in the store.

id.description: kebab-case id; MUST match the target playbook's metadata.id.

title.description: One-line human title (mirrors the playbook's title).

kind.description: Playbook class; lets runners filter (investigate -> investigation, runbook -> procedure). A 'toolbox' entry (v0.4) is NEVER routed to by an incoming symptom; runners compose it as a sub-procedure only.

keywords.description: The natural-language routing triggers a runner matches an incoming request against.

when_to_use.description: One-line guidance on when this playbook applies (disambiguates near-collisions).

path.description: Path to the playbook file, relative to the playbook store (.claude/scout/playbooks/).
